en.html:
No time to explain that word to a person of the Middle Ages. This <ruby>electromagnetic manipulator<rt>Muramasa</rt></ruby> perhaps lacked only the textbook name; she probably <ruby>understood<rt>understanding</rt></ruby> the substance of it perfectly.

A main keep does not depend on one single generating plant, obviously. Another power source would take over very soon. The explosion was bigger than I had expected, and somewhere I could hear things collapsing, but the castle itself falling down, that I did not believe.

The time bought with an unorthodox trick was never going to be much. I would use it properly.

By the sound of feet and breathing I located the side where the cordon had gone ragged, and shoved Ichijou flying toward it.

en.html:
I kicked off the floor and ran.

Straight ahead. Through the center.

I was not following the rule that an outnumbered force should strike only at the commander. Their commander, that monk-robed Kubo, was already out of sight. Had he regained his composure before anyone else and moved?

I knew neither his purpose nor his destination. There was no time to speculate.

I fired the Gattari. Not at flight output—I would only crash into a pillar—but just enough to push me forward and quicken my stride.

　敵将、かの僧形公方は既に姿が見えなかった。この
混乱のなか誰よりも早く平静を取り戻して動いたのか。

　その目的と行方は知れない。推量する時間もない。

なく――柱にぶつかるだけだ――背中を押し出し足を
速める程度の出力で。

en.html:
Even so, in the night air of the castle, that exhaust noise went out like a thunderclap. Through my skin I could feel the attention of the recovering soldiers swinging round to me, all together.

Good.

Now, if Ichijou showed quick action and accurate judgment, escape should be possible.

Quick action, from her, I could expect in full. Accurate judgment, well, leave that aside.

From here on, I had to look after myself.

en.html:
Which way to go, I had no idea. The ally who knew was already dead. Still I advanced: one direction chosen, and that direction only.

If getting out was the only aim, this should do. To cling to the original mission at this stage was foolish; by any reckoning it would cost a life, at the very least. And besides, whether Kuniuji was even here tonight, nobody knew.

No... most probably he had been moved elsewhere. The Kubo of Koga had no reason at all not to do that. In this place, however hard I fought, there was nothing left to win except my own safety—

I chewed on the unwelcome fact.

Both were accomplished fighters, probably of the Rokuhara branch of Yagyuu Shinkage-ryuu. Two years ago I had crossed blades with a fighter of that school. Their swordsmanship closely resembled—and matched—that opponent’s.

en.text:
Men・・.

On what grounds had I decided that?

I had no idea what their sexes were. None had spoken. They had been silent when they appeared, when they attacked, when their blows struck—and when I struck them down.

That discovery strengthened my inference.

ja.html:
<ruby>彼ら<rt>・・</rt></ruby>。
　その認識にふと、疑問が生じる。

　性別など不明だ。彼らは一声も発しなかったから。
　そう、無声だった――現れた時も、打ち掛かる時も、
打ち込んだ時も、打ち倒された時も。

　その発見は俺の推理を補強した。

en.html: Kageaki(The Rokuhara Stable Corps!)

en.html:
They obeyed the Ashikaga family itself more than the shogunate, guarded its members, and handled all kinds of work that must not appear on the surface.

That such a peculiar body existed was known. What it actually was, nobody knew.

Only guesswork. But nothing to refute it with, either. Silent and swift, many yet one body, sunk in darkness with only the sword visible: if these were not the Stable Corps, then who exactly could do the job of Stable Corps?

幕府というより足利一族に服従し、その身辺を守り、
また表にできぬ様々な職務に従事する。
　そんな特異な集団があることは知られていた。実態
まで知る者は、誰もいなかったが。

　推測でしかない。だが否定する材料もない。
　無音にして迅速、群れにして一個、闇に沈んで剣を
顕す――彼らがそうでないなら、一体何者がその厩衆
を務められるというのか。

en.html: That was almost wishful thinking. Suppose the shogunate kept several more groups like this? Bas karo. Let this at least be the last of them, or the weight in my heart would stop my legs.

ja.html:
それは願望に近い想いだった。
　こんな集団を幕府は他に幾つも抱えている――など
と思えば、心の重さで足が進まなくなる。

　せめてこれで打ち止めにして欲しいものだ。

There were many, but they were too far apart to coordinate closely. I made my choice: break through.

Without crossing swords, I threaded the gaps and pressed on.

　そう見切って、俺は選択した。突破。

　剣を交えず、間隙を縫って突き進む。

Every blade was sharp, and <ruby>strong<rt>strong</rt></ruby>. With each cut I dodged, my skin went cold.

But once through, the advantage was mine. They had stopped their feet once to strike; they could not easily catch a man who had kept running.

いる俺に容易くは追いつけない。

en.html:
I barely slid beneath the thrust that came like violet lightning, and scooped my sword upward in reply.

Not enough power to cut through armor. But with the charge turned against the attacker, that warrior went tumbling spectacularly down the corridor.

Luckily, no more enemies came after that one, one by one. I recovered the lost speed and ran along the slippery passage.

　甲鉄を斬り破る威力は欠いた。だが突進を利用され

　幸い、彼に続いて次々と敵が現れる事はなかった。
　鈍った速度を回復させ、滑り易い通路を駆ける。

en.html:
My saliva tasted bitter. I had started to feel I had been underestimating everything.

Against people of this kind, to make an attack on Kuniuji Ashikaga (only for show, true) and then escape cleanly, was that ever possible? From where I stood now, it looked like the daydream of an idiot.

I had taken on something beyond me. That thought came too.

Meddling in the politics of a nation, in history! Such a major affair should have been left to great men or heroes. Why did somebody like Kageaki Minato have to push himself forward? Kya zaroorat thi?

唾が苦い。
　どうも、何もかも甘く見過ぎていたのではないかと
いう気がしてきていた。

　こんな者どもを向こうに回して、足利邦氏襲撃（形
だけではあるが）を行い、まんまと逃げおおせるなど
という真似が……果たして、可能であったのか？
　今となっては馬鹿の妄想としか思えない。

　身の丈に合わぬ事をした。
　そうも考える。

　国家の政治に――歴史に介入するなど。
　そんな一大事は偉人か英雄に任せておくべきだった。
何故、湊斗景明などがしゃしゃり出たのやら。

Then—to the floor below.

en.html:
If the enemy misunderstood and thought I had gone up after Kuniuji, I could earn a great deal of time here. Of course, if someone was running careful heat detection, all of it was wasted. But there was no loss in trying.

At least no pursuer had seen this scene. I took one breath and ran again toward the exit.

あくまで邦氏を狙い上へ向かった――と、敵が誤解

　慎重に熱源探査を巡らせている者がいたなら、全て
無駄だが。やるだけやって損はなかった。

　少なくとも追っ手にこの場面を目撃されてはいない。
　俺は一つ息を吸い、脱出に向けてまた駆け出した。
